verdicts.reason: Both broke the headline into 'CONS TRUC TION' with spaces, which reads as three nonsense fragments. Both also put the price after the CTA, so the order is out of sequence. A at least keeps a legible ORDER NOW button at a reasonable size. Its flaws are a tiny brick and X crammed against 'Buy 2 only for' and an undersized $14.99 jammed in at the right edge. B is more crowded: the brick and X overlap the 'Buy 2 only for' text, the ORDER NOW button is shrunk to illegible fine print so the CTA is buried, and 'Sets for / kids' wraps awkwardly.
